extraClips.note: Real clips present in assets/animations/ that are not bound to a core prototype action yet. Kept, not invented, for future wiring.

format: FBX Binary (.fbx), Skin: Without Skin (animation-only, no mesh), 30 FPS, keyframe reduction: none
important: Player FBX clips now PLAY on assets/characters/Agent_Kyle.fbx via a THREE.AnimationMixer in index.html (loops crossfade, actions are one-shots, crouch poses hold). If Agent_Kyle.fbx or a clip fails the bone-name check, the game falls back cleanly to the procedural capsule animation. Do not claim FBX playback on the capsule itself.
name: Double Agent — animation manifest
rig: KYLE — the uploader's own Mixamo character, present as assets/characters/Agent_Kyle.fbx (1.6 MB).
source: Mixamo, downloaded for Kyle's double-agent prototype. Original Mixamo clips only; no game code in this file.

substitutionsAndGaps.carryHold: Mixamo Carrying hold pose, fixed to the repo clip convention (Hips track ~(0, 0.5, 0) at the seam) and transferred onto Agent_Kyle's armature; the Drive walk_carry_loop fit was not used (its arms swing wide/front-back, not a front carry hold). Held while a body is carried, released on drop.
substitutionsAndGaps.firePistol: Pistol_Fire_Recoil.fbx is built from the Pistol_Aim pose plus a short recoil jolt (arms kick up, torso back, 0.3 s); it does not turn the character. The old Shooting_Pistol.fbx is kept as Shooting_Pistol_Corner.fbx for shooting around corners (lean/peek is now a procedural hold-Q/E-while-aiming lean, 2026-11-14 movement stream).
